app.title: SQL Injection Scanner · One-Click Scan
app.tagline: Enter your target URL and get injection points, database fingerprint, and a full report in minutes.

report.title: Scan Report

validity.negativeReliable: This negative conclusion is reliable (target reachable, not blocked, session valid), but manual review is still recommended - this report does NOT mean "secure"
validity.reliableWithVulns: This scan sent {{total}} requests in total; result reliability is normal
validity.suggestBackoff: Target returned Retry-After; slow down, back off {{ms}}ms and rescan

report.noExtractedData: No extracted data (enable "Data Extraction" in scan config)
report.logTruncated: Log is large; showing the latest {{shown}} lines ({{total}} total)

resumeDialog.title: Confirm authorization scope before resuming

resumeDialog.noConfig: No full config was stored with this record, so the resume can only start from defaults; the authorization scope must be confirmed here.
resumeDialog.scopeLabel: Authorization scope for this resume (empty = no restriction)
resumeDialog.ack: I confirm written authorization for this target and accept resuming without a scope constraint

targetForm.injectionMark: Add {{mark}} at the end of any parameter value to mark injection points
targetForm.urlHelper: Add * at end of param value to mark injection point
targetForm.paramHelper: Add * at end of value to mark injection
targetForm.marksLabel: Marked injection points (only test params with *):
targetForm.marksHint: Tip: Add * at end of param value to test only that point. Without marks, all params are auto-discovered.
targetForm.importFailed: Failed to parse request file: expected Burp/curl text HTTP request format
targetForm.importedWithParams: Imported from request file: {{method}} ({{count}} URL params found)

scanConfig.level: Level (1-5, higher = more thorough but slower)
scanConfig.levelHint: Higher Level = more thorough but slower. 1=URL+Body only, 5=all params+crawler
scanConfig.techniquesHint: Select techniques; all = most thorough but slowest
scanConfig.testPathHint: Treat segments of /api/user/123 as injection points (REST route params often live there). Off = query & body only
scanConfig.testHeadersHint: Treat values of Referer / X-Forwarded-For etc. as injection points (custom headers are often concatenated into SQL). Off = query & body only
scanConfig.extractScopeHint: Runs after an injection point is confirmed. Dump actions really read target data - make sure you are authorized
scanConfig.extractWarning: Only use this feature on authorized targets
scanConfig.enableResume: Enable resume (auto-restore next scan of same URL)
scanConfig.scopeLabel: Engagement scope (CIDR / domain / URL prefix, comma or newline separated)
scanConfig.scopeHint: When enabled, the target and every redirect hop must fall inside the scope or the request is refused - zero packets to unauthorized assets
scanConfig.insecureTlsWarning: Disabling certificate verification removes MITM protection; only for self-signed/internal-CA lab targets, and note it in the report
scanConfig.validationSkipHint: When on, whitelist-blocked params skip 200+ futile requests; when off, full detection still runs (audit/control scenario)
scanConfig.prefilterLabel: Parameter pre-filter (cheap probes before full detection)
scanConfig.prefilterHint: When on, each injection point gets 1-2 cheap probes and obviously dead points are skipped (saves 50-75% requests); when off everything runs in full (audit/control) - do not rely on it to stay under a WAF rate limit
scanConfig.prefilterSingleHint: Off by default for a single injection point: a silent probe is not enough to call the only point clean - high false-negative risk
scanConfig.skipStaticLabel: Skip static parameters (skipStatic, 1 sentinel request per point)
scanConfig.testFilterLabel: Payload whitelist testFilter (comma-separated registry id substrings)
scanConfig.testFilterPlaceholder: e.g. bool,err (keep only entries whose id contains a substring)
scanConfig.testSkipLabel: Payload blacklist testSkip (matched entries are excluded)
scanConfig.useRegistryGate: testFilter / testSkip only take effect once the declarative payload registry is enabled (the flat payload pool has no ids to match)
scanConfig.dbmsHint: Skips fingerprinting (saves 8-9 requests per point); picking the wrong engine means only that engine's payloads run - not detected is not the same as not vulnerable
scanConfig.matchStringLabel: True-page anchor matchString (--string: text the true page must contain)
scanConfig.matchStringPlaceholder: e.g. Added to cart (must be text actually present in the response)
scanConfig.notStringLabel: False-page anchor notString (--not-string: text the false page must contain)
scanConfig.notStringPlaceholder: e.g. You have an error in your SQL syntax
scanConfig.anchorHint: With an anchor the detector decides true/false by substring match instead of similarity scoring; empty = disabled (this is a text value, not a checkbox)

wafTamper.enableLabel: Enable tamper transformation (alters request shape - enable only as needed; the report will be annotated)
wafTamper.intensityTitle: Intensity presets (selecting fills the combination below; fine-tune as needed)
wafTamper.selectedTitle: Selected combination (order = chain order, executed top-down)
wafTamper.notEnabledWarning: Tampers selected but the master switch is off; they only take effect on outbound payloads once enabled.
wafTamper.suggestionTitle: Recommended WAF combination (recommendation only - "Apply" just writes plugins; enable the master switch manually)

disclaimer.title: Safety Notice
disclaimer.para1: This tool (SQL injection scanner) may only be used in authorized environments, such as your own systems, targets with a signed penetration-test authorization, CTF sandboxes, or teaching labs.
disclaimer.para2: Scanning, testing, or extracting data from any system without authorization may violate applicable laws. Users bear full responsibility; this tool is not liable for any unlawful use.
disclaimer.acknowledge: I have read and understood the above and promise to use it only in authorized environments
